title: Nuclear standoff, economic dreams: what the Xi-Kim summit means for N Korea and the world
snippet: Xi-Kim summit analysis: nuclear standoff remains unresolved while economic cooperation dreams dominate. Summit focused on economic cooperation as NK embarks on new five-year plan targeting tourism and housing. Joint statement unlikely to mention Korean Peninsula denuclearization.
tag_reason: 정상회담의 '핵 교착 vs 경제 꿈' 이중구조 분석은 이전 보고서에 없는 신규 분석.
